# Leading Power Apps and Dataverse consultants in Perth

For custom operational apps serving warehouse staff, shop-floor operators, maintenance crews and field teams, I’d prioritise consultancies that can combine **Power Apps + Dataverse + Power Automate + integration with your existing ERP or operational systems**\.

The strongest fit isn't necessarily the biggest Microsoft partner. It's a team that understands how work happens on the ground, can design for tablets and mobile devices, and can deliver reliable, auditable applications that people will actually use.

Based on the publicly available service descriptions and local presence I found, these are the firms I would shortlist first. This is a fit-based assessment, not an independently verified ranking of project quality.

## 1\. Inturing

(Closest match to your use case)

Inturing explicitly specialises in operational business apps for warehouse, shop-floor and field teams, using Power Apps, Dataverse and Power Automate. Its published examples of target workflows include goods-in checks, inspections, job tracking, offline-capable field apps and integration with ERP, MES and other systems. **Why shortlist it\:** Its positioning is unusually specific to operational workflows rather than generic office automation.

**Clarify\:** Its Perth-based delivery arrangements, relevant production deployments and experience with your particular ERP or warehouse system.

[Website: Inturing](https://inturing.com.au/)

It also publishes a field-services automation example involving mobile data capture, timesheets, parts usage and compliance certificates. **Clarify\:** Whether it has delivered barcode scanning, inventory transactions, equipment maintenance or offline shop-floor applications at a comparable scale.

## 5\. iCatalyst

Subiaco · Established Microsoft business applications consultancy

iCatalyst has substantial Microsoft Dynamics ERP and CRM experience and offers Power Platform services. It is worth considering where the project is part of a larger operational systems transformation or needs close alignment with an existing Dynamics environment. [icatalyst.com.au](https://icatalyst.com.au/digitally-transform-in-wa?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why shortlist it\:** Potentially suitable for larger, cross-functional projects where custom apps must fit into a wider business applications architecture.

**Clarify\:** The proposed team's hands-on Dataverse and Power Apps delivery experience for frontline operations, rather than ERP implementation alone.

[Website: iCatalyst](https://icatalyst.com.au/)

## 6\. 366 Solutions

Perth · Microsoft 365 and Power Apps consultancy

366 Solutions offers Power Apps development, implementation, administration and training. Its local consulting focus makes it worth investigating for a more contained application or an initial pilot. [366solutions.com.au](https://366solutions.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why shortlist it\:** A possible fit for digitising a specific operational process without immediately embarking on a large enterprise program.

**Clarify\:** Depth of Dataverse architecture, integration engineering and production-scale frontline application experience.

[Website: 366 Solutions](https://366solutions.com.au/)

## How I'd choose between them

| If your main requirement is… | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| Warehouse, shop-floor or field apps specifically | **Inturing** |
| Manufacturing or field-service workflow automation | **Opticloud Solutions** |
| Complex Dataverse apps with strong governance and audit trails | **BrightMinds Technology** |
| Integration with Dynamics 365 and Microsoft enterprise systems | **Loro IT** or **iCatalyst** |
| A smaller Power Apps implementation or pilot | **366 Solutions** |


## What to test before engaging a consultant

A convincing Power Apps demo isn't enough for an operational application. Ask each shortlisted firm to demonstrate how it would handle these five requirements.

**1\. Frontline usability**

Can operators scan barcodes, capture photos, record quantities, complete inspections and use the app quickly with gloves or on a tablet?

---

**2\. Connectivity and reliability**

What happens when a field worker loses signal or Wi-Fi drops on the warehouse floor? Ask for a demonstration of offline operation and synchronisation if required.

---

**3\. Dataverse architecture**

How will the consultant design data relationships, role-based permissions, audit history, validation and duplicate prevention?

---

**4\. Integration**

Can the app exchange information safely with your ERP, inventory, manufacturing, maintenance or finance systems without unreliable double entry?

---

**5\. Long-term ownership**

Will you receive source solutions, documentation, deployment pipelines, testing, administrator training and a clear ongoing support arrangement?

One further point: ask for the **total cost of ownership**, including Power Apps and Dataverse licensing, premium connectors, integrations and ongoing support. The cheapest initial build may not be the cheapest solution to operate.

## My recommendation

I'd invite **Inturing, Opticloud and BrightMinds Technology** to an initial discussion. They offer three different angles: explicit frontline operational-app specialisation, practical process automation, and governed Microsoft business-app development.

Have all three scope the same real workflow and provide a comparable proposal, rather than asking for generic capability presentations.

**One question that would help me narrow this down further\:** What kind of operation are you building the app for?
